title: Japan Landscapes & Legends | Group Tour Package
highlights: Enjoy a journey across Japan, from Tokyo's bustling streets to Mount Koya's sacred grounds, offering a blend of rich history, diverse landscapes, and cultural heritage.
Cover vast distances swiftly, travelling at speeds exceeding 300 km/h as you board the Shinkansen bullet train, one of the fastest trains globally.
Walk through the path lined with thousands of vermillion torii gates as you visit Fushimi Inari Shrine, known for its peaceful ambience and spiritual significance.
Marvel at the intricate design of Himeji Castle, known for offering panoramic views of Himeji City and a symbol of power during Japan's feudal era.
Wander through the expansive grounds, which include lush gardens and reconstructed towers, as you visit Matsuyama Castle, one of the 12 original castles in Japan.

know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and also upon arrival. PAN card will not be considered a valid address proof.
All international participants will have to share passport and visa details on arrival.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the hotel will be charged at actuals.
Any personal expenses or items of a personal nature will not be included in the package.
Do not consume alcoholic beverages or drugs, if you are found intoxicated, you might be asked to leave the tour/premises.
Learn basic Japanese phrases like "Konnichiwa" (hello) and "Arigatou" (thank you).
Bring a portable charger for your devices, as power outlets may be scarce. Carry an adapter for Type A or Type B sockets.
﻿﻿Remove your shoes when entering someone's house, traditional house or a temple in Japan.
Always remember not to leave chopsticks upright in a bowl of rice, as it's considered disrespectful.
It's not customary to leave a tip for your server in Japan, as tipping isn't a standard practice in restaurants here.
Using your phone for calls during a train or bus journey is considered inappropriate etiquette in Japan.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Leisure Time at Shinjuku District
days.desc: Welcome to Tokyo, the capital city of Japan! Upon arriving at the airport, get transferred to the hotel. After you check-in, relax till noon. In the evening, board the transfer to Tokyo Station and take the metro for Shinjuku District (fare included). After reaching, explore the area at your own pace. You can either spend time at Golden Gai, famed for it vibrant nightlife or relax at Shinjuku Gyeon Park, Tokyo's largest park. Later, board the transfer back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: In the morning, get ready and board the transfer for Tokyo sightseeing tour. During this journey, admire the beauty of Tokyo Tower as you explore Zojoji Temple, known for its Jizo statues. After that, see the busiest intersection in the world, Shibuya Crossing. Then, passing through Omotesando, you'll be driven to see the Imperial Palace and Nijubashi Bridge, followed by a visit to Akihabara and Nakamise Street, among other spots. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Kyoto | Kyoto Sightseeing Tour | Leisure Time at Gion District
days.desc: Post check-out from the hotel, get driven to Tokyo Station to take the bullet train to Kyoto (fare included). Upon reaching, get driven to the hotel to check-in and relax for a while. Later, get ready for the city tour and visit Fushimi Inari Shrine, famed for its torii gates and Kinkakuji Temple, known for its serene gardens, among other spots. Then, get driven to Gion district and spend time at leisure. Later, return to the hotel by local taxi on your own (fare included) for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Osaka | En-route Visit to Todaiji Temple & Horyuji Temple | Leisure Time at Dotonbori
days.desc: In the morning, check-out from the hotel and get driven to Nara to explore the stunning Todaiji Temple, known for its giant Buddha statue and Horyuji Temple, one of the oldest shrines in Japan. Continue the journey to Osaka and upon arriving, check-in at the hotel. Later, in the evening, you'll be driven to the Dotonbori district, where you can enjoy its nightlife and explore various iconic attractions. Afterwards, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Deluxe Hotel

days.title: Transfer to Okayama | En-route Visit to Hemiji Castle | Okayama Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: After getting ready, check-out from the hotel and get driven to Himeji. After reaching, explore its impressive Himeji Castle, famous for its grandeur and intricate architecture. Then, get driven to Okayama and see its stunning Korakuen Garden, famed for its lakes and waterfalls, along with Kibitsu-Jinja, known for its amazing long corridor. After a wonderful day of exploration, get transferred to the hotel and upon arrival, check-in for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Hiroshima | En-route Leisure time at Kurashiki | Hiroshima Walking Tour & Visit to Itsukushima Shrine
days.desc: After you check-out from the hotel, get transferred to Kurashiki and spend some time at leisure. Then, get driven to Hiroshima and upon reaching, enjoy a walking tour of the city covering Peace Memorial Park and Museum, along with Atomic Dome, showcasing the tragic history of 1945 atomic bomb incident. Post that, get driven to Miyajima Island by a ferry to see the serene Itsukushima Shrine, famed for its location and peaceful ambience. Later, get driven back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Matsuyama | En-route Matsuyama Castle, Ishiteji Temple & Dogo Onsen Visit
days.desc: After you check-out from the hotel, board the transfer to Hiroshima Port. Then, take the ferry to Matsuyama in Shikoku Island. Upon reaching, get driven to Shinonome-gucci Station to take the cable car up to Matsuyama Castle, known for its great architecture. Post that, enjoy a visit to Ishiteji Temple, a known pilgrimage site in Japan. Later, get driven to Dogo Onsen, where you can relax in the traditional bathhouse. Lastly, get transferred to the hotel and check-in for an  overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Kobe | En-route Kotohira Shrine, Ritsurin Garden & Uzu no Michi Bridge Visit
days.desc: After checking out from the hotel, get driven to explore the stunning Kotohira Shrine built on the stunning Mt. Zozu. After departing from Kotohira, you'll be transferred to Takamatsu and see its beautiful Ritsurin Garden, famous for its serene ambience. Continue the journey towards Kobe, passing through the famous Naruto Bridge, where you can enjoy walking on Uzu No Michi glass walkway. Upon arriving, check-in at the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Kobe Earthquake Museum Visit | Transfer to Mt. Koya | Mt. Koya Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: After checking-out from the hotel, get driven to explore the beautiful Kobe Earthquake Memorial Museum. Learn about the tragic seism history of the city and its reconstruction. Later, continue the journey towards Mt. Koya, one of the most sacred mountains in Japan. Upon arriving, enjoy a visit to its Okuno Mausoleum and the ancient Kongubuji Temple. Later, relax and unwind at a Buddhist monastery to enjoy Zen meditation and your overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Kyoto | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Post check-out from the hotel, get driven to Kyoto. Upon reaching, check-in and relax for some time. Later, you can explore the city at your own pace. You can explore the Rukiko Temple, home to one of Japan's three greatest pagodas or visit Arashiyama Bamboo Forest, known for its diverse ecosystem. If you wish, you can also visit Maruyama Park, where you can relax and unwind or spend time at Kiyomizu Dera, a serene shrine in the city. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.
